items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Another singer I heard about who is quite popular in the Ivory Coast is Ernesto Djedje, another pop singer.

ctx.x: I heard that there was a trumpet player named Fax Klare that had a club in Treichville and that he did a good imitation of Louis Armstrong. I did meet another trumpet player whose name I don't remember who said that he also had a club in Treichville and all 11 pieces orchestra. Sunday night we decided to visit these clubs and I was in the mood to do some real blowing if the musicians in anyone of the clubs inspired me. But when we arrived at Fax's club, it was closed and it was just about 10 p.m. It was the same…

The most popular male singer is a young African named Francois Lougah, We met him at the U.S. Ambassador's Luncheon, and he came to my last two concerts. He's a pop singer, but a jazz fan. Another singer I heard about who is quite popular in the Ivory Coast is Ernesto Djedje, another pop singer.

The 29th we went to the U.S. Cultural Center to say 'goodbye' to the staff, Mr. Pango and the members of the band. We received numerous gifts and we were feeling sad. We were going to Dakar, Senegal and parting from the Ivory Coast gave Lily and I the feeling that we were losing a very dear friend.
